#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only repo probe: extracts Swirl's historical solver, builds and runs."""
import os
import pathlib
import shlex
import subprocess

repo = pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/422e6ae9ec51/Swirl')
work = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
kit = pathlib.Path('/tmp/swirl-w1-qt/6.10.3/gcc_64')
fixture = pathlib.Path('/tmp/swirl-w1-fixtures/automation-width.ttf')
sha = '50d2a8e8bac702abb2cdc0212f43953b8b78ffef'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', sha + ':src/Swirl.Quick/app/FontManager.cpp'], cwd=repo, text=True)
start = old.index('    // At most 10% of the designer\'s width coordinate;')
end = old.index('    if(chosen<normal){axes["wdth"]', start)
core = old[start:end]
core = core.replace('widthAxis.value("minimum").toDouble()', 'axisMinimum')
core = '\n'.join(line for line in core.splitlines() if 'auto widthAt=' not in line) + '\n'
core = core.replace('{axes["wdth"]=previousWidth;result["axes"]=axes;result["fitted"]=true;return result;}', 'return previousWidth;')
core = core.replace('return result;', 'return normal;')
header = ('// Extracted from Swirl commit ' + sha + '; map returns replaced by coordinate returns.\n'
          'template<class Measure>\n'
          'double oldSolve(double axisMinimum,double normal,double natural,double availableWidth,double previousWidth,Measure widthAt)\n'
          '{\n' + core + '    return chosen;\n}\n')
(work / 'old-solve.h').write_text(header)
cmd = ['g++', '-std=c++23', '-O2', '-DNDEBUG', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror', str(work / 'probe.cpp'),
       '-I' + str(kit / 'include'), '-I' + str(kit / 'include/QtCore'), '-I' + str(kit / 'include/QtGui'),
       '-L' + str(kit / 'lib'), '-Wl,-rpath,' + str(kit / 'lib'), '-lQt6Gui', '-lQt6Core',
       '-o', str(work / 'probe')]
print(shlex.join(cmd), flush=True)
subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
env = dict(os.environ, QT_QPA_PLATFORM='offscreen',
           LD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(kit / 'lib') + ':/tmp/swirl-w1-deps/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu')
run = subprocess.run([str(work / 'probe'), str(fixture)], env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
print(run.stdout, end='')
print(run.stderr, end='')
(work / 'reproduced-results.jsonl').write_text(run.stdout)
